about: Converted prices (contract/converted-prices-2026-10-28.md). When TCGplayer has no price for a finish, the Cardmarket EUR price converted at the ECB rate stands in: usd from eur, usd_foil from eur_foil, never etched; round(eur * rate, 2); left out when under 10% of the cheapest TCGplayer price (any finish) of any printing of the same card. 'printings' go into card_prices; 'want' is [usd, usd_foil, usd_etched, converted] as card_prices_get returns them after the refresh (converted: bit 1 nonfoil, bit 2 foil). 'rows' are card_prices_get rows a client reads: the price of a finish and whether it is converted. 'ecb' is the ECB answer fx_tick parses. Postgres 67_converted_prices_test.sql, iOS ConvertedPriceTests, web convertedPrice.test.ts and Android ConvertedPriceTest read this.
